chunks: And remember the name of your Lord morning and evening;
ai.seo_question: What does it mean to remember the name of your Lord morning and evening?
ai.summary: In Shia tradition, this verse is often linked to the Prophet Muhammad's nightly vigil (Tahajjud) and the Imams' consistent devotion, establishing a rhythm of spiritual discipline that anchors the believer's day. It underscores the necessity of regular, structured remembrance to purify the soul and maintain consciousness of God amidst worldly affairs.
